# Adaptive media fixtures

These fixtures are synthetic and may be redistributed with Gafu. They are not
copied from commercial media.

- `episode.srt` covers multiline cues, overlaps, inflection, a spoken grammar
  contraction, punctuation, and an invalid record.
- `episode.ass` covers ASS event fields, styling tags, line breaks, and commas.
- `evaluation-cases.json` covers candidate evidence, capacity, and source-copy
  rejection cases without copyrighted dialogue.

All expected target offsets use UTF-16 code units into NFKC-normalized cue text.
